gap: Complete All on a page left open overnight whose box reads UNCHECKED completes the next occurrence that the screen still shows as tomorrow's. SEED (desktop 1200x800, America/New_York, clock Tue 2026-03-10 21:00; lists: project p_house 'House', no headings): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Water plants',project:'p_house',when:'2026-03-10',repeat:{mode:'completion',every:1,unit:'day'}},{id:'t2',title:'Fix door',project:'p_house'}], route #/project/p_house. STEPS: (1) Tue 21:00: tick t1's row checkbox. t1 is [x] and a new 'Water plants' W is created for 2026-03-11. The box reads unchecked because Fix door is open. (2) Leave the page open. Set the clock to Wed 2026-03-11 08:00 with page.clock.setFixedTime, no reload and no input. The screen still shows '[x] Water plants', '[ ] Mar 11 Water plants', '[ ] Fix door', and the box is still unchecked. (3) Click the toolbar Complete All (label.tool[for=toggle-all]). The project header's List actions > Complete All and the phone (390px, touch) list menu > Complete All give the same result. EXPECTED (CONTRACT, Repeating to-dos): 'Completing all leaves such an occurrence alone, since it already counts as done with the one before it', and ''Its date is still to come' is judged on the day on screen ... a press remembers the day that was on screen when it began'. On the day on screen (Tue), W's date is still to come. So the click should complete Fix door and leave W open. That is exactly what the same click does on Tuesday evening (control: Fix door [x], W [ ]). ACTUAL (localStorage, 4/4 clean runs: toolbar twice, project menu, phone list menu; no page errors): W 2026-03-11 is marked [x] with completedAt Wed 08:00, so a watering nobody did goes into the Logbook, and a new 'Water plants' 2026-03-12 is created. Fix door is [x]. Clicking the box again to undo does not restore the earlier state: Tue's t1 comes back as a one-off next to Wed's head, and Fix door reopens, so there are two open 'Water plants'. CAUSE: store.toggleAll judges the box on seenDay(), but setCompleted computes spawnedAhead with todayISO(). The toggleAll comment says 'Completing judges still to come on today'. So the completing direction of the r7 fix still uses the clock instead of the day on screen. The harness's overnight test only covers a stale box that reads checked.
